name: ref-defense-change
displayName: REF - Defender protection disabled or configuration changed
description: Defender protection disabled, configuration changed, or Tamper Protection blocked a change. Exclusions, all measured not assumed: 5013 for the three values left tattooed by the deleted REF-SecurityBaseline (POAM-024), and 5007 for Defender housekeeping - UX Configuration notification triggers and the LastMAPSFailureTime timestamp fields, which record state rather than change it. 5007 on any actual protection setting still alerts, as does every other Tamper Protection block.

criteria.query:
Event | where ingestion_time() > ago(5m) | where EventLog == "Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender/Operational" | where EventID in (5001, 5004, 5007, 5010, 5012, 5013) | where not(EventID == 5013 and RenderedDescription has_any ("DisableBlockAtFirstSeen","DisableRoutinelyTakingAction","DisableScanOnRealtimeEnable")) | where not(EventID == 5007 and RenderedDescription has_any ("UX Configuration","LastMAPSFailureTimeString","LastMAPSFailureTime","\\Diagnostics\\","IsServiceRunning","ServiceStartStates","WdConfigHash","InitializingComponentProgress","LastSignatureUpdateResult","DLP Configs\\Tag")) | extend OldV = extract(@"Old value:.*?=\s*(\S+)", 1, RenderedDescription), NewV = extract(@"New value:.*?=\s*(\S+)", 1, RenderedDescription) | where not(EventID == 5007 and isnotempty(OldV) and OldV == NewV) | extend LocalTime = format_datetime(datetime_utc_to_local(TimeGenerated,"America/Los_Angeles"),"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss") | project LocalTime, Computer, EventID, Actor=UserName, Detail=substring(RenderedDescription,0,400)
| where not(EventID == 5007 and Detail matches regex @"New value:.*SpyNetReporting\s*=\s*0x2")   // RA-027 12 Oct: MAPS re-set to the policy value at service start
